text: dsh-codex 将 ChatGPT Codex OAuth 和账户可用模型接入 DSH。使用 /codex-auth 登录后，可在 DSH 选择 Codex 模型并通过 pi-ai 适配器调用。插件会刷新账户模型目录，适合希望在 DSH 使用 Codex 订阅模型的用户；需要 ChatGPT for Codex 账户和浏览器授权。

dsh-codex adds ChatGPT Codex OAuth and account-visible models to DSH. Sign in with /codex-auth, then select Codex models for inference through pi-ai. The catalog refreshes for your account. Requires a ChatGPT for Codex account and browser authorization.
想用 ChatGPT Codex 账户里的模型在 DSH 对话。
DSH 怎么通过浏览器登录 Codex 订阅？
让 DSH 显示我账户当前能用的 Codex 模型。
我登录后模型列表变化了，如何让 DSH 更新？
Use my ChatGPT Codex subscription models from DSH.
How can I sign in to Codex from my DSH profile?
dsh-codex 的功能「Codex 登录」：运行 /codex-auth 发起订阅账户授权，完成浏览器登录；本机回调不可达时可粘贴重定向 URL 或授权码。
dsh-codex 的功能「动态模型目录」：根据已授权账户刷新 Codex 可用模型，目录变更后同步到 DSH 的模型服务；未知且无法执行的目录项不会作为模型提供。
dsh-codex 的功能「Codex 模型调用」：在 DSH 模型路由中选择 openai-codex 模型并通过适配器请求推理，适配器检查模型目录并保留流式传输错误状态。
怎样在 DSH 里重新加载 Codex 账户的模型？
Refresh the Codex models available to my account in DSH.
@askdkc/dsh-codex README · dsh-codex：English | [日本語](./README.ja.md)

@askdkc/dsh-codex README · Usage：Install the plugin from a DeepSeek Harness checkout:

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add github:askdkc/dsh-codex
```

Replace `web` with the target profile name, then restart that profile.

For ACP, install the plugin in the ACP profile too:

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile acp add github:askdkc/dsh-codex
```

@askdkc/dsh-codex README · Usage：Profiles load plugins independently: installing into `web` does not add models to `acp`. Restart the DSH process launched by your ACP client, then reopen its model selector. If the client uses a different profile, replace `acp` with that name.

@askdkc/dsh-codex README · Usage：This plugin ships prebuilt `lib` files and does not need install-time build scripts. If an installation or update fails with `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS` naming `codex-subscription-oauth-plugin`, edit the target profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (by default, `~/.dsh/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml`). In its existing `allowBuilds` map, explicitly skip this package's build scripts:

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  codex-subscription-oauth-plugin: false
```

@askdkc/dsh-codex README · Usage：Change an existing `codex-subscription-oauth-plugin: true` to `false`. Delete any other `allowBuilds` entries whose key starts with `codex-subscription-oauth-plugin@`, including repository URLs, commit URLs, and generated `set this to true or false` placeholders. Keep only the name-only `false` entry for this package and preserve other packages' settings. Save the profile file before retrying.

@askdkc/dsh-codex README · Usage：Unlike a name-only `true`, a name-only `false` also applies to Git dependencies: pnpm records an explicit decision to skip the scripts, so updates do not require commit-hash edits. This recovery works with pnpm 11.7.0; upgrading pnpm is not required. See pnpm's [Git dependency build settings](https://pnpm.io/settings/build#allowbuilds).

@askdkc/dsh-codex README · Usage：Then rerun the failed `pnpm dsh plugin ...` command from the DeepSeek Harness checkout. Even an update of another plugin checks this profile's dependencies; for example, retry a failed Kiokuko update with:

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web update kiokuko-dsh --latest
```

Wait for the command to exit successfully. `Already up to date` can appear before a build-policy error and does not by itself mean the update succeeded.

@askdkc/dsh-codex README · Usage：Use the same profile for the configuration edit and retry; adjust the path for a custom `DSH_HOME`. Running `pnpm approve-builds` in the Harness checkout targets that checkout, not the plugin profile. Changing `minimumReleaseAge` does not resolve build approval failures.

If installation into an existing ACP profile fails with `ERR_PNPM_UNEXPECTED_STORE`, reinstall that profile's dependencies using the current pnpm store, then retry:

@askdkc/dsh-codex README · Usage：```sh
pnpm --dir ~/.dsh/profiles/acp install --force --frozen-lockfile
pnpm dsh plugin --profile acp add github:askdkc/dsh-codex
```

The first command rebuilds the profile's `node_modules` without changing its lockfile. If it fails, resolve that error before retrying the plugin installation. If you use a custom `DSH_HOME` or profile name, adjust both commands. The `allowBuilds` hint printed after a store mismatch does not fix this error.

Sign in to ChatGPT for Codex:

```text
/codex-auth
```

@askdkc/dsh-codex README · Usage：Complete the browser login. If the localhost callback cannot reach DSH, paste the redirect URL or authorization code when prompted.

Remove the plugin:

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web remove codex-subscription-oauth-plugin
```

@askdkc/dsh-codex README · Models and connection diagnostics：The plugin bundles the pi-ai 1.5.0 Codex catalog, so every model the authenticated Codex endpoint currently lists as visible has executable metadata without a manual model table: GPT-5.6 Luna, Sol, and Terra; GPT-6 Astra, Luna, and Sol; and GPT-6.1 Sol and Terra. Account visibility and ordering still come from the authenticated catalog at `https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/models`; an account that cannot see a model does not receive it.

@askdkc/dsh-codex README · Models and connection diagnostics：GPT-6.1 Sol and Terra use the Codex default 500,000-token context, 128,000-token output capacity, text and image input, and the reasoning levels recorded in the catalog. Their prices come from the OpenAI API model pages. Unknown entries that the live endpoint lists but the bundled catalog cannot execute emit `MODEL_METADATA_MISSING` and stay hidden; their capabilities are not guessed from another model.

@askdkc/dsh-codex README · Models and connection diagnostics：Connection failures retain the SDK's before/after-start phase, fallback choice and safe error code. Raw close reasons, stacks, headers and bodies are omitted from these diagnostics. The SDK may switch to SSE before its first response event; the plugin adds no retries and does not replay an interrupted response or tool output. Cancellation stays cancelled, and an SSE HTTP error retains its status for the host's classification.
